card.name: Partway through job-title words
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before a job title, where the next piece is an agent ending like -er, -ian, -ist, officer or coordinator. Seen in names of trades and staff roles.

modes.label: Split occupation words
modes.description: A word stem inside a trade or profession name, before an ending like -ician, -ist or -er.
modes.example: we all have been given these unique gifts and talents - some to be doctors, some to be<< opt>>icians, some to make super pong tables

modes.label: Modifier in a staff title
modes.description: A noun in a multi-word title that is followed by officer or coordinator.
modes.example: Erin Marie Blasco, Public<< Programs>> Coordinator, Smithsonian National Postal Museum

card.writes: It promotes person-role endings such as officer, 员, 师 and 士, so the title is completed.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a job title, when the next piece will name the person's role.
